description: This walk takes you from the Dartmoor village of Chagford to one of the local highlights at Fingle Bridge The route runs for a distance of 3.5 miles, following a section of the waymarked Dartmoor Way. It's a pleasant and easy walk, taking you along the River Teign to the historic bridge in a north easterly direction. The stone bridge spans the River Teign in Teign Gorge and is a popular tourist destination and a Grade II* listed building. There are also some more fine walking trails in the surrounding woodland.
